card.statement: If $\mathsf{F}(\mathscr{F})$ or $\mathsf{F}(\mathscr{G})$ is flat over $\mathbf{k}$, then $\mathscr{F}\mathchoice{\mathbin{\mathop{\boxtimes}^{L}}_{\mathbf{k}}}{\boxtimes^{L}_{\mathbf{k}}}{\boxtimes^{L}_{\mathbf{k}}}{\boxtimes^{L}_{\mathbf{k}}}\mathscr{G}$ is perverse.

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
